articles.title: Macy's postpones Thanksgiving parade in New York due to weather | BBC News
articles.titleZh: 梅西百货因天气原因推迟纽约感恩节游行 | BBC新闻
articles.summary:
Macy's has postponed its 100th annual Thanksgiving Day Parade in New York to Saturday because of severe weather.
 
Preparations to hold the iconic holiday celebration, known for its massive balloons that float among the city's skyscrapers, had already begun when the forecast for heavy rain and strong winds on Thursday led to the delay, according to the BBC's US media partner CBS News.
 
The last time the parade was suspended was during World War Two, but it has never been postponed due to weather. In 1971, Macy's decided to ground the balloons, which often feature beloved characters from pop culture, because of weather.
 
A powerful coastal storm is set to affect the New York area in coming days.

Subscribe to our channel here: https://bbc.in/bbcnews

For the latest news download the BBC News app or visit BBC.com/news

#BBCNews

articles.title: Is this the future of US power? Bukele's Haiti experiment? | The Global Story
articles.titleZh: 这就是美国权力的未来吗？布克莱的海地试验？|《全球故事》
articles.summary:
El Salvador’s President Nayib Bukele has embarked on a military operation in Haiti, deploying troops on the ground, armed robot dogs and posting flashy videos on social media of air strikes, in an effort to help Haiti tackle gang violence.

Thousands of Haitians have taken to the streets marching in support of the polarising leader, but the speed and tactics of Bukele’s military operation has led to questions over whether it is legitimate and legal.

Tristan Redman speaks to Catherine Norris Trent, senior correspondent at France 24, who has reported extensively from Haiti for years, on whether Bukele could be the solution to the country’s years-long chaos, and whether Donald Trump’s strongman ally could be using Haiti as a blueprint for US-sanctioned international peacekeeping.

Subscribe to our channel here: https://bbc.in/bbcnews

For the latest news download the BBC News app or visit BBC.com/news

#Haiti #ElSalvador #BBCNews

For the latest news download the BBC News app or visit BBC.com/news
articles.readingTextZh:
萨尔瓦多总统纳伊布·布克莱（Nayib Bukele）已在海地发起军事行动，在当地部署了部队和武装机器人犬，并在社交媒体上发布了空袭的炫目视频，以帮助海地应对帮派暴力。

数千名海地人走上街头，游行支持这位备受争议的领导人，但布克莱军事行动的速度和策略引发了人们对其合法性和合规性的质疑。

特里斯坦·雷德曼（Tristan Redman）与法国24电视台高级记者凯瑟琳·诺里斯·特伦特（Catherine Norris Trent）进行了对话。特伦特多年来一直在海地进行大量报道，她谈到了布克莱是否能够成为该国多年混乱的解决之道，以及唐纳德·特朗普的强人盟友是否可能将海地用作美国批准的国际维和行动的蓝本。

如需了解最新资讯，请下载BBC News应用或访问BBC.com/news

articles.title: Macy’s Parade Postponed for the First Time in Its 100-Year History
articles.titleZh: 梅西百货游行在其100年历史上首次被推迟
articles.summary: For the first time ever, Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade, balloons and all, will not be held on Thanksgiving due to severe weather concerns. Plus, new developments tonight in the Nvidia saga, including a new report that senior members of the administration weighed invoking a wartime law, dating back to the Korean conflict, to get Jensen Huang his job back, after being ousted for an affair with an alleged Chinese spy, and others.
articles.summaryZh: 直接播放媒体官方频道发布的新闻视频，保留记者原声、现场声音及原始语速。
articles.sourceNote: Official publisher video · original English audio
articles.readingText:
For the first time ever, Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade, balloons and all, will not be held on Thanksgiving due to severe weather concerns.

Plus, new developments tonight in the Nvidia saga, including a new report that senior members of the administration weighed invoking a wartime law, dating back to the Korean conflict, to get Jensen Huang his job back, after being ousted for an affair with an alleged Chinese spy, and others.
articles.readingTextZh:
由于恶劣天气原因，梅西百货感恩节游行（包括气球等所有内容）将首次不在感恩节当天举行。

此外，今晚Nvidia事件又有新进展，包括一份新报告称，政府高层考虑援引一项可追溯至朝鲜战争时期的战时法律，以让因涉嫌与中国间谍等人士有染而被罢免的Jensen Huang官复原职。
